known_outcome: Regulator position: SCO judgement can settle many occupancy-classification questions without a variance, but for the F-1 and F-2 distinction the STANDATA reaffirms the variance application, review and enforcement process; it is not a guide to the engineering analysis.
review_focus: Separates the SCO's discretion from the variance route the document names
Flags the engineering analysis the file would need as outside the STANDATA's scope
Asks why an AHJ might reject the application at the outset, and what the file should show
Does not say the change is acceptable
alberta_evaluation_use: source extraction and administrative evidence exercise; not technical approval
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
